baseline_gate.name: Legacy non-regression baseline ready
checks: Verify local and remote main still equal the approved baseline before starting.
Run all PR_REQUIRED quality matrix and documentation checks on the exact baseline SHA.
Run the workflow-defined WP14 recovery, documentation evidence, and full engineering jobs to terminal state.
Classify every failure, skip, marker deselection, optional dependency, and unavailable raw input without changing its outcome.
Confirm 0.2.10 tag/artifact/source and historical maturity records remain unchanged.
baseline_gate.pass: Both authoritative workflows are terminal success on the exact baseline SHA; all job outcomes and skips are explicitly recorded; no baseline drift or historical reclassification occurred.
baseline_gate.fail: Any unexplained required-job failure, missing required workflow/job result, baseline SHA drift, or attempted threshold/status weakening.

selection_policy: Do not run every repository verification file indiscriminately. FAST_DEVELOPMENT is the exact module selector from the touched capability rows; PR_REQUIRED and RELEASE_CANDIDATE_REQUIRED use the existing authoritative workflow commands without changing markers, thresholds, or maturity policy.

FAST_DEVELOPMENT.purpose: Fast, change-impact regression while iterating locally.
FAST_DEVELOPMENT.command: python -m pytest -q <the tests[] modules listed by the touched capability rows in wp01_capability_matrix.json>
mandatory_rules: Include all listed unit modules for every changed capability row and directly coupled row.
Add its listed integration module when routing, public IO, or assembly changes.
Add its listed tests/verification modules when formulation, solver, accepted observables, reference mapping, or maturity-facing behavior changes.
Do not select unrelated benchmarks or evidence archives just because they are present.
FAST_DEVELOPMENT.comparison_policy: Use existing per-case assertion tolerances and frozen qualification acceptance metrics. Preserve complex phase, reactions, energy, residual, state/history and diagnostic observables where the row names them. No tolerance is widened after viewing a result.

PR_REQUIRED.purpose: Required pull-request gate for every 0.2.11 source PR.
commands: python -m ruff check src/qf_solver src/solveur tests scripts
python -m mypy src/solveur/core/errors.py src/solveur/core/qualification.py src/solveur/io/manifest.py src/solveur/verification/traceability.py

python -m pytest tests/unit tests/integration -m "not benchmark and not large and not evidence" --cov=solveur --cov-branch --cov-report=term-missing:skip-covered --cov-report=json:coverage.json --cov-report=xml:coverage.xml --cov-fail-under=80
python -m compileall -q src scripts tests qf_solver.py main_solveur.py mitc4_solver.py

selection_and_skip_classification.optional_evidence_skips: tests/conftest.py marks archive-backed cases skipped unless QF_SOLVER_RUN_EVIDENCE=1 and both qualification/vnv and docs/generated/docs_manifest.json are available; report these as SKIPPED in the PR matrix, not PASS.
selection_and_skip_classification.optional_gmsh_skips: The two modules in OPTIONAL_MESH_TEST_MODULES are skipped when gmsh cannot import; report SKIPPED and require the controlled benchmark/docs-evidence jobs where relevant.
selection_and_skip_classification.recovered_archive_cases: The nine exact WP14 cases are skipped unless the verified recovered archive is provided; the required WP14 job provides it separately.

PR_REQUIRED.pass_rule: All required jobs succeed on all four matrix entries, docs workflow succeeds, and current coverage/quality thresholds remain unchanged. A skip is reported as SKIPPED, never converted to PASS.

RELEASE_CANDIDATE_REQUIRED.purpose: Full release-candidate regression and evidence campaign.
RELEASE_CANDIDATE_REQUIRED.workflow: Quality and verification on the exact candidate SHA plus Documentation tests on the same SHA.

WP14 recovered evidence / targeted check.external_input: The workflow downloads and verifies the pinned WP14 evidence archive; without that exact archive the job is NOT_AVAILABLE/FAIL, not PASS.

commands: QF_SOLVER_EVIDENCE_ARCHIVE_ROOT=<verified WP14 archive>; QF_SOLVER_RUN_RECOVERED_EVIDENCE=1 python qf_solver.py verify-all --profile engineering

Documentation evidence / ubuntu-latest.result_handling: Keep generated report status and individual expected failures/skips visible; a successful documentation build is not a maturity promotion.

commands: python scripts/verify_authorized_release_artifacts.py --contract <new frozen 0.2.11 contract> --source-contract <source mapping contract> --dist <audited dist directory> --output <audit.json>
Frozen selected package and public docs.note: Exact arguments and accepted artifact source are set only when the 0.2.11 release contract is frozen; never reuse 0.2.10 bytes as a 0.2.11 candidate.

RELEASE_CANDIDATE_REQUIRED.pass_rule: Every required workflow job is terminal success; each artifact/checksum is tied to the exact candidate source; all per-case historical failures remain represented with their original statuses.

OPTIONAL_EVIDENCE.requirement: Run only when the exact solver build, deck, raw archive, units, and reference digests are provisioned; correlation is not physical validation.

OPTIONAL_EVIDENCE.item: WP12 R4 external raw gallery replay
OPTIONAL_EVIDENCE.requirement: External archive and Code_Aster runtime are not guaranteed on standard CI runners.

OPTIONAL_EVIDENCE.classification: OPTIONAL_DEPENDENCY unless the changed scope is the bounded distributed route
OPTIONAL_EVIDENCE.requirement: For the accepted bounded linear-static distributed scope, use its exact unit/verification tests; do not infer nonlinear, dynamic, contact, scaling, or general MPI maturity.

OPTIONAL_EVIDENCE.classification: MISSING in the clean baseline checkout
OPTIONAL_EVIDENCE.requirement: A new run can produce new evidence but cannot reconstruct original missing bytes or rewrite their historical status.

numerical_comparison_contract.bitwise_identity: Required only for immutable source/artifact/provenance bytes and explicitly deterministic serialization contracts; not required for floating-point solver outputs by default.
numerical_comparison_contract.reference: Use the named case's frozen reference and tolerance policy in its qualification record. If a record does not freeze an acceptance tolerance, report the numerical result diagnostically and do not promote or claim a new pass.

modal: MAC/subspace principal angles for repeated or clustered modes
Newmark_and_harmonic: energy/dissipation and restart suffix where recorded
distributed: serial/reference equivalence for the exact accepted case
collective completion and output digests where recorded

provenance_key_for_new_vnv: model/input identity and actual external-file digests
